name: Love Hospital
source:
In the year 2114, on a distant planet called "Smile World" that mirrors Earth's civilization, 'Byron' is a positive and lively young man suffering from a rare disease. After entering university, he starts feeling the limitations of his body and, following advice from his bio-implant, decides to seek treatment at a top-tier hospital.

What awaits him there? A team of charming nurses, of course! The way his hospital life unfolds depends on your choices. Will you create a romantic comedy or something even more unexpected?

Check into the hospital now and create your own story!

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3561620/]Steam[/url]]
